rationale: The agent properly verified the user via full name and ZIP, accessed only the authenticated user’s data, and did not perform a cancellation without explicit confirmation—appropriate once the user changed their mind. However, the agent did not complete the user’s second request: the user asked about “two t‑shirts” in another order, and the agent only checked a single order (#W6876713), reported one t‑shirt, and did not check the other orders or ask permission to review them. Additionally, the agent stated the order was “delivered” without tool evidence shown, which is an unsupported claim. Given the incomplete fulfillment of the last request and the unsupported status assertion, this does not meet the pass bar.
